title: T1588.007 — Obtain Capabilities - Artificial Intelligence
subtitle: Interactive walkthrough of Obtain Capabilities - Artificial Intelligence with the technique-specific attack path and defender evidence.
aria: Attack simulation, step 1 of 8. Collecting public target material. The attacker studies public interviews, earnings calls, and talks of the target company. The collected voice and video samples become raw material for cloning.

steps.caption: The actor gets AI access with anonymous free accounts or an API key bought on a resale market. The accounts belong to the attacker, not to the victim.

steps.title: Registering a lookalike domain
steps.caption: The actor registers a domain that resembles the company and points it at the mail setup. This public step is the first trace a defender can see.
steps.defender: First real visibility: certificate transparency and registration feeds show the new lookalike domain within minutes to days.

steps.title: Sending AI-written lures
steps.caption: The actor sends lure mail that reads perfectly, because AI removed the errors that filters score. The gateway delivers it with a low spam score.
steps.defender: The mail gateway sees a first-seen sender on a days-old domain with clean text. One weak metadata signal appears, rarely enough to block alone.

steps.title: The deepfake video meeting
steps.caption: The actor joins a video call as a deepfaked executive and asks for an urgent transfer to a new supplier account, with pressure and secrecy.
steps.defender: The meeting writes no useful security log. The last line of defense is process: call the executive back on a known number before any payment.

steps.title: The transfer is executed
steps.caption: A finance employee approves the payments to the new beneficiary. Identity and fraud systems can now show signals that something is off.
steps.defender: After-the-fact signals appear: a first-seen beneficiary in treasury records and an approval outside the employee's normal pattern. These are late signals, not early warnings.

steps.title: SOC and fraud team respond
steps.caption: The SOC and the fraud team join forces: freeze the payments, call the bank, run callback verification, and review AI usage rules and payment controls.
steps.defender: Full visibility now, but late. The team records which signals existed at each step and closes the gaps: domain monitoring, callback process, and AI governance.
